There’s a disturbing pattern where they seem to wait until your condition worsens before they’ll actually intervene. I never thought I’d become suspicious of doctors’ motives, but this surgery has confirmed my worst fears - it genuinely feels like their business model relies on patients getting sicker to justify more appointments and billings.

The approach here is dangerously passive. They’re dismissive, reluctant to prescribe, refer, or take any meaningful action whatsoever. It feels like they’ve turned healthcare into nothing more than an appointment factory, booking patients in to hit their base rates while actual patient comfort and health outcomes don’t factor into their decisions at all.

If you value your health, find another surgery immediately. This place is disgraceful and frankly should be investigated by the CQC. When a patient leaves a surgery more suspicious and cynical about doctors than when they arrived, something is fundamentally broken with that practice.
